findings.summary: The core preflight requires six separately declared prerequisite skills and directs missing-source recovery to a prerequisite guide outside this two-file package.
findings.impact: A host without the declared skill sources or the external guide cannot proceed to grouping or handoff; the package remains dependent on unbundled prerequisites even though it stops safely. Record this for prerequisite governance.
